review_scope: exact official evidence-unit locator and complete-claim entailment
detector_claim: A LEA CTR initial-counter role must have an operative width of 16 bytes.

evidence_review.entailed_fragment: LEA has a 16-byte block for every specified key-size variant.
evidence_review.missing_fragment: The units do not state that every CTR initial-counter object must be represented by one 16-byte C array.

evidence_review.entailed_fragment: CTR uses an incrementing counter as the encryption-transform input and requires a different initial value per encryption.
evidence_review.missing_fragment: The located units do not give an exact initial-counter byte extent or a C declaration representation requirement.

program_fact_requirements: authenticated build manifest binding compiler, arguments, include roots, macros, and source occurrence
Clang-resolved array extent and symbol identity
dataflow proof that the symbol is the operative CTR initial counter
review_note: LEA block width alone cannot bridge the normative, representation, and symbol-role claims. No shadow extractor may be treated as semantic evidence at this gate.
